---
name: Boulder Bug Hunt
description: Investigate and fix a bug in Boulder with minimal changes.
agent: Boulder Safe Fix
---

- Ask for a description of the bug and where it appears if that context is missing.
- Trace the relevant code paths across this Apps Script project (and the web app if relevant).
- Suggest the smallest code change that can fix the bug.
- Confirm the plan, then apply the change and show diffs.
